parameters.negative_prompt: news broadcast, stock footage, advertisement, 3d animation, computer graphics, cartoon, watermark, logo, text, on screen text, subtitles, titles, signature, slow motion, dramatic reaction, handshake, contract signing, celebration, distorted face, distorted hands, extra fingers

response.prompt:
Continue this exact close-up for five seconds as a restrained real-time observational documentary
shot at native 24 fps. Preserve the woman's face, apparent age, hair, small hoop earrings, dark teal
work shirt, camera-right eyeline, workshop geometry, and natural late-afternoon window light. Keep
the camera completely locked. She remains silent and calm, holding her attention just off camera
toward the buyer. Allow one natural breath, one restrained blink, and at most a tiny eye shift that
suggests she understands the weight of the question. Her expression stays capable and reflective,
never anxious, sad, confused, defensive, or theatrical. No smile, frown, fear, lip movement, nod,
dramatic reaction, body turn, hand gesture, camera move, pan, zoom, dolly, slow motion, focus pull,
third person, other face, paperwork, readable text, logo, watermark, or anatomy drift.
